response.text: Let me start by verifying key things with several queries.

arguments.sql: select h.jrnl_no as j, 1 as x from (select 1) t, (select "JRNL_NO" jrnl_no from "GLJRNL" group by "JRNL_NO" having sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT")) h

select i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", i."STAT_CD", (select sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO") dr, (select sum("CR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO") cr, (select sum("CR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000') ap from "APINVH" i where i."INV_AMT" <> coalesce((select sum("CR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000'),-1) or i."INV_AMT"<=0

select l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT", c."ACTV_FLG" from "GLJRNL" l left join "GLCOA" c on trim(c."ACCT_CD")=trim(l."ACCT_CD") where c."ACCT_CD" is null or c."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y'

select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where h."POST_DT" not between p."STRT_DT" and p."END_DT" or (p."CLOSE_DT" is not null and h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT") or (p."STAT_CD"='C' and p."CLOSE_DT" is null)
